personal.name: Akshay Anvekar

projects.title: Self-Hosted Edge AI Agent on NVIDIA Jetson
bullets: Built a private, self-hosted AI agent on NVIDIA Jetson using llama.cpp and CUDA to run quantized language models locally with tool calling support.
Containerized the model server, vector database, REST API, and user interface with Docker, enabling fully offline operation without cloud LLM dependencies.
Optimized model quantization levels and context settings to balance memory usage, response speed, and accuracy on edge hardware.
